subject: help with inserting text in a graph

messages.author: 7f3170e7815a360a
messages.subject: help with inserting text in a graph
parts:
Hi all,

I am using a very simple code to add a text to a graph:

ggplot(my.subset,aes(time.transit,child_mortality, group=as.factor(country.x),colour=as.factor(my.democracy)))+
  geom_line()  + geom_vline(xintercept = 0,size=1,linetype=2)+   xlab(expression("Years to and from Democratic Transition")) +   
  xlab(expression("Years to and from Democratic Transition")) + m +ylab(expression("Child Mortality Rates")) +
  ylab(expression("Child Mortality Rates")) +  theme(legend.position="none") + 
  geom_text(aes(25, .37, label="Democracy")) + geom_text(aes(-25, .37, label="Dictatorship")) +
  ggtitle("Transitions and  Mortality Trajectories") 


However, geom_text() is producing very ugly results (see attached). Any clue why?

Thanks in advance
